description: Magnetic hysteresis loops (M-H) of AgxCo1-xFe2O4 nanoparticles, four thick solid lines (black x=0, red x=0.05, blue x=0.1, magenta x=0.15) with a boxed legend inside the top-left corner; applied field -2.1..2.1 kOe, magnetization -55..55 emu/gm. Four-quadrant Origin chart in a closed box frame with thin black zero lines through the origin; outward ticks on the bottom and left frame lines only (majors every 0.5 kOe / 10 emu/gm, minors halfway). Journal figure (Tahir et al. 2023, Sci Rep 13:15730, Fig. 13, whole figure as served), 968x809 PNG. Hand-labelled by pixel analysis (Pillow/NumPy/SciPy): positions are image pixels, origin top-left, integer = pixel centre, +/- ~1 px. Provenance and licence: fixtures/real/PROVENANCE.md.

xAxis.notes: axisLineRow is the bottom frame line (black, 2 px), which carries the ticks; the thin zero line (col 531.68) carries none. Outward majors (8 px) at -2.0..2.0 every 0.5 kOe, outward minors (5 px) halfway. Labels "-2.0" ... "2.0" (title says "KOe").

yAxis.notes: axisLineCol is the left frame line (black, 2 px), which carries the ticks; the thin zero line (row 354.52) carries none. Outward majors at -50..50 every 10 emu/gm, outward minors at the fives.

pitfalls: Four-quadrant: thin black zero lines (row 354.52, col 531.68) cross the frame and the X zero line runs into the "0" label row; they carry no ticks.
Boxed legend (x=0 ... x=0.15 with thick line samples) in the top-left corner of the frame, touching the frame lines.
Labels with decimals ("-2.0", "-0.5", "0.0") and hyphen-like minus signs; axis title unit "KOe" (capital K), Y unit "emu/gm".
Loops are not single-valued in x and the four nearly vertical branches crowd at the origin.
Low resolution (968x809, Arial-like labels ~15 px tall); ticks only on the bottom and left frame lines.
